# peakhour_rp_ssl_config (Resource)

Manages RP SSL/TLS settings for a domain (cipher profile).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_ssl_config" "example" {
  domain  = "example.com"
  ciphers = "intermediate"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `ciphers` (String) Cipher profile (spec enum: intermediate, modern, old).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RP SSL config identifier (domain/rp_ssl_config).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_ssl_config.example example.com
```
